recentItems.title: Republican midterm message: Democrats are the threat | AJ #shorts
recentItems.description:
“Communists.” “Islamists.” Republican speakers portrayed Democrats as a threat to America on night two of their midterm convention in Dallas. Al Jazeera’s @EmmaWithrow reports on how they’re turning questions of national identity and events in the Middle East into campaign ammunition.

recentItems.title: Al Jazeera explains massive Israeli blasts on south Lebanon hill
recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: EU sues Ireland over turf-cutting: Age-old tradition under threat
recentItems.description:
Ireland’s centuries-old peat-cutting tradition faces an EU ban over carbon emissions. For thousands of households, peat remains a vital source of heating, sparking a clash between climate policy and cultural heritage.

Al Jazeera’s Peter Smith reports.
